iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (XK for Kosovo). The key that joins every module.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (XKK for Kosovo, as in CLDR).

iso_numeric.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code, as text to keep leading zeros.

kind.description: country (sovereign state, including Palestine, Vatican and Kosovo) or territory.

official_name.description: Official long name in Arabic, when a source states one.

aliases.description: Other Arabic names people search with. For search only, not display.

flag.description: Flag emoji (regional indicator pair). Windows does not draw these; use flag_svg on the web.

flag_svg.description: Path of the 4:3 SVG flag in this package.

continent.description: africa, americas, asia, europe or oceania (UN M49 via CLDR).

un_member.description: true for the 193 UN member states.

tld.description: Country-code top-level domain, when one is delegated.

sort.description: Arabic sort key: compare these with plain string comparison for correct Arabic order (ignores «ال», hamza forms, tashkeel).
